evidence: The slow fp8/tp8 config recovers from 5832 to 10400 tok/s on driver 560 (a 0.56x factor, and rtx5090 shows the same 0.56x between 570 and 560); on driver 570, bf16 (6484) beats fp8, tp2 (3361) beats tp4 (3246), while chunked_prefill=1, llama33-70b, qwen25-32b and rtx5090 all stay degraded, so the drop needs driver 570, fp8 and tp>=4, regardless of model, GPU or chunked prefill.
